items.title: Borosil Renewables hit with customs order over solar glass plant machinery classification
items.text: An Additional Commissioner of Customs order dated 15 Oct 2026 rejected the tariff classification Borosil Renewables used for imported solar glass plant and machinery. Goods valued at Rs 14,14,43,335 were confiscated, with redemption on a Rs 30,00,000 fine, plus penalties of Rs 30,000 and Rs 30,00,000 (about Rs 60.3 lakh in total by the article's figures). The company says it will pay under protest, appeal to the Commissioner of Customs (Appeals), and expects no material effect on operations. The amount is small, but the order relates to the machinery for its 1,000 to 1,600 TPD glass expansion.
